Paintable Indicator

[![Paintable Indicator](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/f/ff/Paintable_Indicator.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317005832)

Like the [paintable sign](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Decorative#Other "Wiki/Building/Components/Decorative"), but you can add "additive color" which will glow when the backlight of this block is enabled.
